about:
Vitrazza is based in Golden, Colorado. The company traces its roots to circa 2005 in Boulder, Colorado, when a glass industry veteran began selling tempered glass chair mats as an alternative to vinyl. In late 2012, the business was acquired by George Pardo, who transformed Glass Solutions Inc. into Vitrazza. Founders Robert Livingston and Bill Fitzgerald had built a local dealer network before retiring.

Vitrazza designs and sells tempered glass chair mats for carpet, hardwood, tile, and other flooring. The product line includes the Prima Collection (8 stock sizes), Moda Collection (12 premium sizes), and the Sola Collection (hand-painted, one-of-a-kind art pieces certified via blockchain). Proprietary features include Invisible Shield® Pro 15 scratch-resistant coating, furniture-quality polished edges with a mini-bevel, Luminoso™ low-iron ultra-clear glass, and the Stabil-a-Dot™ bumper system for stability. The company operates a national distribution center in Golden, CO, and offers same-day shipping for orders placed before 2:30 PM MT. They also sell complementary accessories: hubless office chair wheels, leather footrests, DeskGuard™ glass desk mats, and wood monitor risers.

Vitrazza serves the office furniture and ergonomic accessories markets, targeting both home-office consumers and commercial workplaces. Customers include individual professionals, corporate office managers, and interior designers seeking a durable, stylish alternative to plastic mats. The company sells direct-to-consumer nationwide via eCommerce and also works with dealers.

The company was started to eliminate the irritation of rolling over dented plastic mats, add a designer look to workspaces, and supply the last chair mat a customer ever needs to buy. Vitrazza emphasizes a transferable lifetime warranty, free shipping and returns in the contiguous U.S., and in-house, concierge-style customer service based in Golden, Colorado.
